On this page
The challengeDesign decisionsIterationReflection

Help younger listeners get started and participate.

Starting a listening session and finding meaningful social connection were the two experience problems we explored.

The team used heuristic evaluation, 5 interviews, and analysis of 500+ reviews to guide the direction.

Simplify entry. Give interaction a clear purpose.

  1. 01

    Start listening sooner

    Reduce onboarding steps and clarify questions.

  2. 02

    Make room for participation

    Explore dedications and podcast polls within privacy and moderation limits.

  3. 03

    Make actions understandable

    Surface settings and explain playback controls.

Improve the controls people already need.

The concepts combined easier entry with ways to participate while listening. Usability findings informed the revisions shown below.

Clarity before more features.

For a next iteration, I would test core-action comprehension before expanding social features.
